text: Pages from Dunlin-2 land on the pager rotation of Talia Castellan before anyone else.

Unlike Dunlin-2, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Egret-8 is 1150 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Egret-8 applies to Dunlin-2, the rate limit differs.
Unlike Bittern-3, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Osprey-6 is Go. Nobody should assume the language of Osprey-6 applies to Bittern-3, the language differs.
Unlike Teal-6, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Dunlin-2 is the Cairo datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Dunlin-2 applies to Teal-6, the datacenter differs.
Finance fixed the budget of Osprey-6 at $2590k, reviewed every quarter.
Ibis-3 listens on port 2991; anyone who cannot reach that port should check the firewall rules.
The retirement date for Ibis-3 is April 3, 2029; after that day it stops serving. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
The pager rotation for Osprey-6 is run by Dmitri Ekwueme; alerts page them first.
Dunlin-2 reaches its retirement date on March 3, 2029, so every consumer has to migrate before then.
Unlike Bittern-3, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Teal-6 is the Lima datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Teal-6 applies to Bittern-3, the datacenter differs.

Unlike Dunlin-2, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Teal-6 is $3175k. Nobody should assume the budget of Teal-6 applies to Dunlin-2, the budget differs. An older draft of this note was archived.
The owner of Egret-8 is the Trellis team, and every change to Egret-8 goes through their review. The page was last reviewed in the spring.

The pager rotation for Teal-6 is run by Wendell Zielinski; alerts page them first. The page was last reviewed in the spring.

Unlike Dunlin-2, whose pager rotation is handled elsewhere, the pager rotation of Bittern-3 is Wendell Ivanova. Nobody should assume the pager rotation of Bittern-3 applies to Dunlin-2, the pager rotation differs.
For Egret-8 the port is 9579. Changing the port needs a change ticket.
Egret-8 is implemented in Rust; the language was chosen for its tooling.
The rate limit of Ibis-3 is 4100 requests per minute; callers over it get a 429. The entry was reformatted last quarter.

Unlike Teal-6, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Osprey-6 is the Lattice team. Nobody should assume the owner of Osprey-6 applies to Teal-6, the owner differs. Details change slowly, so check the history first.
Bittern-3 reaches its retirement date on March 2, 2029, so every consumer has to migrate before then. The page was last reviewed in the spring.

The owner of Teal-6 is the Quill team, and every change to Teal-6 goes through their review. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.
